主要内容: DISH Network CORP announced on May 7, 2013, the ratification of the appointment of KPMG LLP as its independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2013. The company also amended and restated its Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The voting results showed strong support for both proposals, with over 2.5 billion votes in favor of the KPMG LLP appointment and over 2.5 billion votes in favor of the amendment to the Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
